backend/main.mo: Motoko backend storing golf events per user, computing Callaway results, and sorting golfers by net score using a chart-based deduction system.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence listing two chart‑persistence features with linked files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Mapping of frontend file paths to short descriptions of their purpose and behavior.
frontend/docs/callaway-chart-defaults.md: Documentation explaining where default Callaway chart values are defined and how code changes interact with localStorage overrides.
frontend/DRAFT_RESTORED.md: Notes indicating a restored editing draft with no functional changes to the production app.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind/OKLCH theme variables for light and dark mode plus base styling.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point loading the React SPA via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component orchestrating app navigation, golfer data flow, validation, and Callaway score calculation.
frontend/src/features/admin/AdminView.ts: Admin interface gating chart‑editing tools behind an access flag and rendering the Callaway chart editor when enabled.
frontend/src/features/admin/CallawayChar: UI for editing 9- and 18‑hole Callaway grid charts with validation, per-cell updates, and save/reset actions.
frontend/src/features/eventSetup/EventSe: Form for configuring event details including title, course, golfer count, hole count, and par with validation.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Breakd: Displays a detailed scoring breakdown for a golfer, showing gross, worst holes, deduction, adjustment, and net score.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Callaw: Renders a read‑only Callaway scoring chart table for 9 or 18 holes with explanatory notes.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/export: Generates a print‑optimized HTML window and triggers the browser’s print dialog to export tournament standings as a PDF.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Leader: Shows ranked leaderboard rows, handling ties and formatting net, gross, deduction, and adjustment values.
Full leaderboard page with titles, standings table, PDF export, and detailed breakdown panels.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/GolferS: Renders a list of golfers with editable names and hole scores, updating totals and propagating changes to the parent.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/validat: Validates golfer data by ensuring name, hole count, and all stroke values are present and within allowed limits.
frontend/src/features/settings/SettingsV: Displays application settings including a toggle for enabling admin access and a back button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s identity and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides authentication context using Internet Identity, handling login, stored identity loading, and logout.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks using the backend actor, including fetching the latest result when available.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets global Tailwind styles and theme variables for light and dark golf‑themed UI palettes.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callaway.ts: Computes Callaway handicap and net score using the active scoring chart, including worst‑hole deductions and adjustments.
Defines Callaway chart structures, built‑in 9‑ and 18‑hole charts, and logic to select the correct entry for a gross score.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callawayChartP: Provides localStorage persistence for Callaway charts and grid data, including defaults, user defaults, and active edited charts.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/state/adminAccess.ts: Manages admin-access enablement via localStorage with getter and setter functions.
frontend/src/state/eventTypes.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for event setup, golfer data, and Callaway scoring results.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS theme, colors, animations, and plugins for the frontend.
project_state.json: Describes project metadata, features, and state related to Callaway chart persistence and defaults.
